records.readable_german: Fuer UKS. Groesserer Verkehr zu erwarten. Haben Sie sichere Verbindung mit UKS, oder muss OSM vermitteln?
records.title: Expected heavier traffic: direct UKS connection or OSM relay
records.meaning: Heavier traffic is expected. The sender asks whether a reliable direct connection to UKS exists or whether OSM must relay it. The question does not establish that either link is functioning.

records.readable_german: I. P. M. ZU1163EPB41N. Verkehr auf allen Strecken Suedungarns unterbrochen. Armee tritt 4 / 11 Fussmarsch nach Nordosten an.
records.title: Two-part march notice and officer dispatch: a priced editorial reading
records.meaning: The linguistic proposal says that traffic on all routes in southern Hungary is interrupted and that the army begins a foot march toward the northeast on the date label 4/11. The opening I P M ZU1163EPB41N remains opaque. This is an edited reading of the printed garbles, not a new independent witness to the intended words.
records.reading_note: The native 210-coordinate frame fixes all 105 raw positions, but the body contains repeated garbles. The readable proposal costs 14 observed-coordinate substitutions; many are printed D changed to proposed G. The full ledger below preserves every one. The opening IXPXMXZU1163EPB41N is unchanged, including every letter and numeral. Word-internal raw 8 and 4 labels are changed only through priced source-coordinate substitutions; the date 4/11 is untouched. No source mask, frame change, key adjustment or independent parallel is used. Re-encryption proves the exact proposed transformation, not a unique historical reading.

records.readable_german: Generalstabsoffz. im Flugzeug wird entsandt. A. O. K. 11. Eins 4. 7023.
records.title: General Staff officer to be dispatched by air; literal closing EINS4 and 7023
records.meaning: The second part says a General Staff officer will be dispatched by aircraft. The closing retains A O K 11, EINS4 and 7023 as transmitted labels. This announces a future dispatch and does not establish that the flight took place.
records.reading_note: The two dashes in VDV-- remain two source slots. Filling them supplies the missing S of GENERALSTABSOFFZ and I of IM. Two observed-coordinate substitutions separately propose ENTSANDT for EN0SANRT. The raw 0 inside that word is changed through the explicit coordinate ledger; the footer 4 and 7023 are not relabeled or normalized to a presumed staff designation.
